english.title: Holder of a driving licence in the form of a photocard fail to surrender it for change of photograph
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the holder of a driving licence in the form of a photocard, failed to surrender it to the Secretary of State within a period of ten years beginning with the date shown as the date of issue on

(A)_[that licence]_
(B)_[the earliest licence bearing the same photograph as that licence that had been renewed or replaced]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(2A) and (5) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
